text: Invariant's next goal, as @gitdek put it on 2026-11-03, is that he can build new projects with it and use it on his existing ones, large or small. He chose to stop #421's plan after step 3, #445, since steps 4 to 6 mostly automate this repository's own merger work, and to put plumbing on any repository, #452, first: on any repository but this one, the factory takes no plumbing yet (D-0121). Adopting existing Python and Go code through the factory, a lighter setup and short steps that don't wait behind builds come after it.
